text: Kirin Lion was the former Animal King on the O-Kan Island who appeared in the third One Piece movie.
Kamijiro is a lion's head, legs, and tail that are attached to Holed'em's body due to his consumption of a lion SMILE.
Toratsugu is a non-canon resident of Wano Country. He is a former florist and prisoner who ate a Devil Fruit that turned him into the yokai Nue.

A Supply Station is a position stocked with materiel in support of a military or police operation. It may take the form of a Weapon Crate, Supply Drop, or Tactical Gear crate containing weapons, ammunition, and gadgets. They may also allow the player to change their loadout.
Wild Joe is one of the main antagonists of Eiichiro Oda's one-shot Wanted!. He is killed early in the story, returning as a ghost and haunting his killer, Gill Bastar.
Zoryu the Three-Headed Dragon is one of the gacha prizes that can be won from Gacha Gacha Island's giant gacha machine.

is a hero that was created for the pitch meeting for Prometheus, which became Overwatch. Her design is taken from unused Titan concept art. She was one of the marquee heroes prominently featured in the Prometheus "hero lineup" key art. She had the following abilities: *Crossbow *Multishot *Imbue Shot

A Tank Destroyer is a vehicle designed to engage enemy armor. Much how artillery crews are mobilized as mobile artillery vehicles, anti-tank guns that were formerly towed or emplaced could now move across the battlefield under their own power. Tank destroyers of the World War II era were typically tracked vehicles with heavy armor, while modern designs are often adapted from infantry fighting vehicles. This means some of them are also capable of carrying a contingent of troops to support their objectives.

"Simon" was the name given to one of the gorilla test subjects at the Horizon Lunar Colony. His official designation was Specimen 9. After being subjected to genetic modification, Simon was among the gorillas that began showing belligerence towards their human overseers. He developed a following of sorts with "fellow troublemakers," including Hypatia. One night, Patel complained of noises in the break room. Nevsky discovered that Simon and his gang were behind it, and thus confined Simon and his fellows to their quarters. This prompted Nevsky to suggest that all the test subjects likewise be confined, so that the test subjects wouldn't take their actions as favouritism. Not long afterwards, the gorillas launched an uprising, killing the staff and took the colony as their own. Years later, Lucheng Interstellar was able to retrieve information from Horizon's still-operating monitoring system. Simon was noted to still be in the colony.
Braloha (Japanese: トコナッツ Tokonattsu) is a and elemental Pal.

Blood Stasis is a unique Dread Primate which appears as an Invasion Boss, as part of a double boss with Blood Morpher. She casts an aura that slows her enemies. Blood Stasis casts , , and . Blood Stasis is based on Nadia the Soothing from The Dread Thicket.
Cave Beast is a gargantuan found in the Den in Act 2. They are slow but have a strong melee attack.

The was a Japanese submachine gun designed in 1940 by Nambu Arms Manufacturing Company. It was first issued to the Imperial Japanese Army in 1940, usually only to officers, and its production continued to the end of the war. It used the cartridge in a 30-round magazine. Early models had a rate of fire of 450 rounds per minute, however, the 1944 models had a rate of fire of ~800 rounds per minute. It was heavily based on the Bergmann MP 18, and used a chrome body for resistance against humidity, giving it a sleek, silver-like finish.
Chatters is a unique Skeleton located in The Lower Prison in Act 1. He uses and casts an aura that increases the cold damage of his allies.
Champion of Frost is a unique Skeleton located in . He uses and casts an aura that increases the cold damage of his allies. He is based on Chatters from The Lower Prison (Act 1).

Charred Skeleton is a type of melee Skeleton found in the missions of Catarina, Master of the Dead. Unlike most skeletons, their bones are a dark red colour, and they trail little whisps of fire when they move.

The is an unmanned autonomous helicopter unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) developed by Northrop Grumman for use by the United States Armed Forces. The Fire Scout is designed to provide reconnaissance, situational awareness, aerial fire support and precision targeting support for ground, air and sea forces. The initial RQ-8A version was based on the Schweizer 330, while the enhanced MQ-8B was derived from the Schweizer 333. The larger MQ-8C Fire-X variant is based on the Bell 407.

Compulsor Octavia Sparkfist is a unique Blackguard Arcmage, located on the top floor of The Upper Sceptre of God. She is one of Dominus' champions. She deals lightning damage using Spark totems and Lightning Warp.
Coniraya, Shadow of Malice is the vaal side area boss for the Forgotten Oubliette. He is a Spectral Bowman with ranged attacks.
Corrupted Iceweaver was a type of Skeletal Mage which appears in the waves of Elreon missions. Corrupted Iceweavers shoot Cold Bolts.

The Type 95 "Kurogane" (Japanese: 九十五式黒金 Kyujugo-shiki kurogane; English: Type 95 Black Metal) was a Japanese reconnaissance vehicle designed during the mid-late 1930s and used during World War II. It was the only completely Japanese-designed reconnaissance vehicle ever used by the Japanese Army. Between 4,700 and 4,800 were built.
Corrupted Fireshot was a type of Skeletal Archer which appears in the waves of Elreon missions.
Commander of Flesh is the vaal side area boss for Ancient Catacomb. He primarily uses Wild Strike. As he takes damage, he moves faster and summons zombies.

The (Japanese: 九九式軽機関銃 Kyūkyū-shiki Kei-kikanjū) was a Japanese light machine gun designed by Kijiro Nambu in 1939 and produced by Japan until the end of World War II. It was a modified re-chambered version of the Type 96 LMG (which fired 6.5x50mm Type 38 Arisaka cartridges) and was designed to fire 7.7x58mm cartridges to have more stopping power and bullet penetration. It was also generally more reliable than the Type 96 with the addition of other minor improvements.

Fire and Fury is a unique Sea Witch located in . She is based on Ambrosia, Daughter of Merveil from The Cavern of Anger. She deals fire damage using and . She also has an aura that increases the fire damage of her allies.

Fragment of Winter is the map boss of . It is based on the hostile ice golem monster. e.g. Icy Manifestation, Brittle Shard, etc. Fragment of Winter has invulnerability phase that summon small ice golem known as Volatile Ice. Volatile Ice will be exploded on death.

Fire Golem (internally Fire Elemental) is a subtype of golem found in-game as hostile monsters. The player can also summon friendly fire golem via . The initial version is released in version 2.0.0 as Volcanic Golem. This monster has construct internal tag.
The M167 VADS (Vulcan Air Defense System) is an American made short-range rapid fire Gatling gun using a 20mm cannon. It is featured in Battlefield: Bad Company and Battlefield: Bad Company 2.
Gneiss is a unique Rock Golem located in The Old Fields (Act 2).
Goatman Fire-raiser is a type of Goatman found in Prisoner's Gate (Act 6).
Lunarsworn Wintermage is a caster Humanoid monster found in Act 8.

The Type 85 (Chinese: 85式冲锋枪 1985 shì chōngfēngqiāng; English: 1985 model submachine gun) is a Chinese submachine gun that was developed in the 1980s to replace the Type 79 with a more inexpensive weapon. A silenced version was also made to replace the aging silenced Type 64. It fires the 7.62x25mm Tokarev round that is used in a number of Russian and Chinese-made weapons.
Master of the Blade is the map boss for the . He is based on the unique bandit, Kraityn.

Quetzerxi is a unique Dust Scrabbler who is the boss of the vaal side areas Abandoned Dam and Dusty Bluff. When hit, it will cast 6 lightning projectiles that always pierce. Hence deadly in party or using multiple-hit-reliant skills.

Rhys of Abram is a unique zombie found in the Twilight Strand in Act 6. Like most zombies, Rhys moves slowly and attacks with unarmed strikes. Dark spirits intermittently leap from Rhys, dealing physical damage in a small area of effect where they land. When Rhys is slain, several of these dark spirits leap from his corpse all at once, covering a wide area.

The Type 79 is the first Chinese made submachine gun that was not based off another country's design, unlike many of China's weapons at the time it was designed. It fires the Russian 7.62x25mm Tokarev round that was originally made for the Tokarev TT-33 used in World War II.
Shavronne of Umbra was a thaumaturgist and an important historical figure in Wraeclast.

The Faun is a unique Goatman located in The Climb, guarding Navali's cage. Killing him frees Navali. The Faun will enter the zone by dropping down from the sky, killing nearby monsters when he lands.

The Type 91 is a 35mm grenade launcher made originally as a stand-alone weapon to fire non-lethal 35mm grenades. It usually comes equipped on the QBZ-95 assault rifle, firing a multitude of non-lethal and lethal 35mm grenades, but can also be vehicle mounted as well. It is a lightweight single-shot and breech loading launcher, similar to the American M203.
Volcanus is a unique Cinder Elemental which is the boss of . He is based on Hatebeat from The Crematorium. He deals fire damage using and by rolling over his enemies.

The Tuk-tuk (Thai: ตุ๊กตุ๊ก Tuk-tuk; English: Motor tricycle) is the Thai nickname given to an auto-rickshaw, a three-wheeled miniature truck. Tuk-tuks are popular in South and Southeast Asia as they provide a cheap and small transport vehicle to be used for taxiing services or for transporting commercial goods.

The UAZ-8 Ocelot (Russian: УАЗ-8 Оцелот) is a fast attack vehicle (FAV) used by the Pan-Asian Coalition during the 21st and 22nd Centuries and is featured in Battlefield 2142. The driver only has access to capability and the vehicle horn. The gunner has a light machine gun turret to repel infantry. A third passenger has access to all of their personal equipment. Though protected by light armor, all passengers are exposed to some degree. Positioned in a rear interior seat, the gunner is the best protected, but less so than the gunner on the MK-15 Bandit. The passenger is highly exposed. The vehicle does not carry Active Defense System or any missile warning system.

The UD-12 Shepherd is a VTOL (Vertical Take Off and Landing) aircraft used by the European Union in the 22nd Century. It is encountered in Battlefield 2142, being a usable aircraft. It functions identically to it's PAC counterpart — BTR-20 Yastreb.

The Type 98 (also known as the ZTZ-98) is a main battle tank used in limited service in the People's Liberation Army of China and is manufactured by Norinco. It is part of a line of third generation tanks to replace the aging Type 90 MBT's that are based on the Soviet T-72 design. The newest version is the Type 99A, but only the prototype and early production model has been made into Battlefield franchise. __TOC__

The Type 85 HMG is a heavy machine gun designed in China for the People's Liberation Army. It is a further improved version of the Type 77 heavy machine gun, which was a new design aiming for replaces DShK. It is used on vehicles much like the American M2 Browning, but it was primarily designed as an anti-aircraft gun as it is usually issued with a low-magnification scope that has a targeting reticle for both infantry and aircraft. The weapon can also be used on a lightweight tripod and can attach a tubular shoulder stock for infantry use.

The WZ-551 (official designation by the PLA is ZSL-92 or Type 92) a 6x6 amphibious wheeled armored personnel carrier used by the People's Liberation Army and developed and built by Norinco. The IFV variant - which appears in Battlefield 2 - is armed with the indigenously produced ZPT-90 25x183mmB autocannon - based on the Soviet 2A14 23x152mmB used on the ZU-23-2 and bored out to 25mm, or the French GIAT M811 25x137mm cannon that was acquired through a deal between France and China in a different turret, and the vehicle armed with the French cannon is called NGV-1. The vehicle is also armed with a coaxial 7.62mm machinegun which can be replaced with an HJ-8 ATGM launcher if necessary. Another variant is armed with a single 12.7mm machine gun, called the WZ-551A instead.

The Type-53 is a Chinese copy of the Soviet DPM light machine gun, itself a modernized version of the DP designed in 1943-44. This version of the Degtyaryov design used a more robust bipod, and added a recoil spring in a tube near the rear of the stock, which necessitated a pistol grip. By the early 1950s, the DP machine guns were being phased out by the RPD, and the design was sold to China, who then exported it to communist bloc nations such as North Korea and North Vietnam.

The , also known as the Vickers Gas Operated was a rapid-firing machine gun that was predominately used during World War II. The weapon was developed and manufactured by to be used in aircraft to defend against the enemy. Some models were later adapted for ground use by special forces.

This Zoroark is a -type Pokémon owned by Mohn, who then joined his son Gladion in the present.

The RDA-1 (Russian: РДА-1; Разведывательно-дозорный автомобиль; "reconnaissance-patrol car") is a Russian lightweight transport vehicle used by the VDV, the Russian Airborne Troops. The vehicle was made from scratch by Lieutenant Colonel Anatoly Lebed for the 45th Guards Independent Reconnaissance Brigade, based on a Lada Niva. Only one example of the vehicle was produced, which took Lebed roughly a year to make. It was first shown at a military exercise in the Pskov Oblast in March 2010. The vehicle is mounted with a NSVT heavy machine gun. The RDA-1 appeared in the Battlefield series under the name VDV Buggy. __TOC__

An Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), commonly known as a drone, is an aircraft without a human pilot aboard. The flight of UAVs may be controlled with various kinds of autonomy: either by a given degree of remote control from an operator, located on the ground or in another vehicle, or fully autonomously, by onboard computers. __TOC__

It originally accompanied Liko's great-great-grandmother, Rystal, 100 years ago, until it entered a dormant state. As of , it has joined Liko's team. The USS George H.W. Bush (CVN-77) is the tenth and final Nimitz-class super carrier of the United States Navy. She is named for the 41st President of the United States George H. W. Bush, who was a naval aviator during World War II. Bush's call sign is Avenger, after the TBM Avenger aircraft flown by then-Lieutenant George Bush in WWII. Construction began in 2001 at the Northrop Grumman Newport News shipyard and was completed in 2009 at a cost of $6.2 billion. She is home-ported at Naval Station Norfolk, Virginia. She is one of the largest vehicles ever built by man and by far the largest weapon ever built, being around over 332 meters (1092 feet) long and weighs 100,000 tons. She carries a crew of over 5000, giving it a nickname of floating city.
Psychic of Duality is a -type Sync Move introduced in Pokémon Masters. It's the Sync Move of Liza and her Lunatone.
Rapidashtwo is a -type Pokémon created by Mewtwo in Pokémon The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back.
This Flygon is a /-type Pseudo-Legendary Pokémon owned by Raihan.

The Bell Boeing V-22 Osprey is an American multi-mission tilt-rotor aircraft with both a vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL), and short takeoff and landing (STOL) capability. It is designed to combine the functionality of a conventional helicopter with the long-range, high-speed cruise performance of a turboprop aircraft. The V-22 Osprey appears in three games in the Battlefield series. A future development of the aircraft utilizing jet engines appears in as the MV-38 Condor.
This Charizard is a /-type Pokémon owned by Red. When it Mega Evolves (into Mega Charizard X), it becomes a /-type Pokémon.

The Alien Tactical Advantage Explorer, often shortened to A.T.A.X., was a member of the Space Marines, part of a secret elite special forces unit. A.T.A.X. had the highest possible mission success ratio and his insertions have had significantly lower casualty rates than air/ground offensives alone. A.T.A.X. notably assisted Lieutenant Ripley's squad on TerraForm 3 and its Lunar Installation in combatting various lifeforms. He quickly gained their respect after rescuing them from a horde of Bull Aliens and then defeating a slew of Snake Aliens single-handedly.

The Alien Dragon was a encountered on the moon LV-426 by a United States Colonial Marine Corps squad several years after the Hadley's Hope incident, alongside several winged Chestbursters. It was ultimately killed by the Marines deep underneath the ruins of the colony.

An underslung rail allows weapon accessories to be attached to the underside of a firearm. Many accessories such as foregrips, bipods and flashlights are compatible with rails. Today there are many different rail-systems, like the NATO standardized M1913 "Picatinny" rail or the older, and partly compatible Weaver-rail. The rail was implicitly used in Battlefield 2, Battlefield 2142, and Battlefield: Bad Company 2 for their respective assault rifle attachments.

Aly Lugar was a crewmember on the exploratory vessel . Following an incident on the planetoid LV-1113, Lugar was infected by a dangerous alien pathogen and underwent a transformation into a higher being. In 2185, the changed Lugar led an attack on the mining station Erebos.

Big Red, also known as the Samurai Predator, was a Yautja encountered by Batman in Gotham City, and the Leader of a hunting party. Big Red is distinguished by his unusual red armor which includes a red bio-helmet with black ornaments and golden Wristblades.

A Warrior was birthed from colonist Anne Cregar, who was impregnated by a Facehugger during an infestation in the colony of Trono on the planet LV-871. The birthing of the Xenomorph caused a large commotion on the escape shuttle Anne and her son, Maxon, had boarded, culminating in it crashing onto LV-871's surface. Though presumed dead by the surviving civilians, the now adult Xenomorph began stalking Maxon and the survivors during their plight for survival across the planet.

The VBL (Véhicule Blindé Léger) is a light armored, all-terrain vehicle developed by Panhard in France. The vehicle is known to be amphibious, along with protection from small-arms fire, mines, shrapnel from artillery and possibly chemical WMDs.
Back Biter was a massive alien creature locked within the arena where warriors captured by the Grendel King's people competed in an arena on Yautja Prime. It was killed by three of the captives.

Charles Bishop Weyland was a billionaire industrialist and the founder and CEO of Weyland Industries. In 2004, he organized an expedition to Bouvetøya, Antarctica to investigate an ancient Pyramid buried beneath the ice there. The Pyramid was discovered to be a temple and hunting ground where the Predators would breed s for use in their Hunts, and the expedition soon became caught up in the battle between the two species. Weyland was killed in the Pyramid by Scar when he attacked the Predator with an improvised flamethrower.

Brigette was a Venture Corporation synthetic, originally designed for sexual gratification before being repurposed as a lab assistant to Dr. Gagnon, following an incident where she broke the arms of a client who attempt to cut her open with a razor. Despite being a synthetic, she was cautious when it came to the Xenomorph egg, even though it shouldn't have posed a threat to her.

The Type 72Z is an Iranian-developed, extremely modernized version of the Soviet T-55 tank. The upgrades to the T-55 which creates a Type 72Z is the replacement of the older 100mm D-10 main gun with the 105mm M68, to allow for a longer service life, high efficiency, and simple replacement process without needing to remove the tank's entire turret, as well as an improved stabilization system for the main gun. The Type 72Z also features an improved power supply, engine, and unified internal systems into a so-called "power pack", designed to allow for a shorter repair time.
The Bionic Predator was a who possessed several cybernetic enhancements.

Eloise, commonly referred to as Ellie, was an experimental, vat-grown -android prototype created by Doctor Fred Lichtner. Eloise would later go rogue and form her own brood of s on the planet LK176, attacking any intruders who disrupted her peace.
Archbishop Emoji was a psychic, robo-messiah and false prophet, hell-bent on destroying the human race.

The Ultimax 100 is a light machine gun, developed by the (CIS, now ST Kinetics). It chambers the cartridge. The Mk 5 variant is an updated variant of the Ultimax family, which was developed for the USMC's Infantry Automatic Rifle competition with STANAG magazine compatibility, a folding stock, and Picatinny rails; the Ultimax 100 lost to the M27 IAR. Another modernized variant known as the Mk 8 was unveiled in 2012, that adds a semi-automatic firemode, and expanded magazine compatibility.

Emil Zorn was a cyborg mercenary and bodyguard to neophyte explorer Wellington Frick. He partook in an expedition led by Frick to a distant planet where they encountered a pyramid-like structure, housing treasure. He is eventually killed by a Warrior within the pyramid's interior.
Ghost, also known as the Ghost Predator, was a lone reputed for his speciality in hunting Super Predators.

Hunter Borgia was the CEO of Borgia Industries and the son of Bruno and Isabella Borgia. Together with his mother, Hunter was credited with the reconstruction of Neonopolis after the almost complete destruction of the original city, New Way City, by the known as Scarface. Born a stunted weakling with little prospect of long-term survival, Hunter was granted new life when exposed to Scarface's Yautja blood shortly after his birth. Perhaps as a result, Hunter became obsessed with the Yautja, using his family's company to develop and market Prometheus Tech derived from stolen Predator technology. Later in life, Hunter progressed to experimenting on himself genetically to become a Yautja-human hybrid, although he was killed by Scarface before the process could be completed.

Unmanned Combat Air Vehicle, or UCAV for short, is an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) equipped with aircraft ordnance (such as missiles) and is able to perform drone strikes. The UCAV in Battlefield 4 is based on the AeroVironment Switchblade, a remote-controlled loitering munition developed by AeroVironment. Loitering munitions are aerial drones equipped with warheads (or ordinance with UAV-level guidance equipment) designed to recon for enemy targets in the air and then perform "Kamikaze" attacks by directing themselves towards their targets. Loitering munitions fit a niche between cruise missiles and UCAVs, and has similarities to both. __TOC__

The Harbinger was a pathogen-mutated variant with six-arms and a large vertical mouth dominating its body. The Harbinger would relentlessly pursue victims and attempt to pin them down with its claw-like arms.
A bioluminescent irradiated Drone was active during the year 2214 within the dilapidated colony of Hadley's Hope. It stalked and killed most members of the extremist journalist group, Renegade XM.

Warrant Officer Ramya Nandasiri was a member of the Three World Empire's Royal Marines Commandos. Nandasiri held a record for long–distance shooting, having bullseyed a target at perihelion in Mars orbit from the Ishikori-dome Solar Mirror Array above Earth using the Weyland-Yutani Corporation's L33 Pike rifle. To achieve the feat, Nandasiri used orbital slingshot trajectories and mental computation; her shot hit home two years after she had fired it.

The Shin Guntō (Japanese: 新軍刀, lit. "New army sword") is a Japanese military sword adopted by the Imperial Japanese military from 1935 to 1945, issued to military officers as a symbol of rank. A traditional Japanese katana-styled sword, it replaced the Western-styled Kyū guntō (old military sword) as the standard Japanese military sword. There were three versions of the Shin Guntō: Type 94, Type 95, and Type 98, which increasingly simplified the sword's design.

Private First Class Ricco Frost, nicknamed "Frosty" or the "Zen Master" owing to his cool attitude, was a member of the United States Colonial Marine Corps, part of 2nd Battalion Bravo Team. He was a member of the combat unit deployed to LV-426 aboard the in 2179, to investigate the sudden loss of contact with the colony of Hadley's Hope. He subsequently perished as a result of the infestation at the colony. Frost was part of Second Squad's rifle team, along with Corporal Dietrich, and was also a skilled martial artist, holding a first-degree black belt in the Marine Corps Martial Arts Program. He was killed by friendly fire inside the Hive when Dietrich accidentally set him alight with her flamethrower.
The Science model 270D4 was a humanoid synthetic model. One of which, designated David Sereda, was placed aboard the Vidar on assignment to Chione.

Each was armed with an advanced mono-katana made from Yautja technology that the , Scarface, had left behind in 1930 during his New Way City hunt. 's POV as the Ronin battle Hunter Borgia.]] The three Ronin differentiated themselves by each wearing a different color; red, blue, and green. The Ronin were supposedly skilled in "Ten thousand ways to kill", and they frequently proved this when they dealt with threats to their mistress, Lucretia. They were sworn to die if it was needed to protect Lucretia, and they had the chance to prove it when Hunter Borgia had apparently killed his daughter in his blind fury. The Ronin aided Scarface in his battle against Hunter, and depending on how well Scarface fought and hurt Hunter, they either died or some or all of them lived.

undergoing "short-track" repair.]] Disabling Vehicles is a concept featured in various games in the Battlefield series. When disabled, vehicle movement, weaponry, or other functions are unavailable for various reasons. Low-flying air vehicles that are disabled are likely to crash to the ground. However, limited use of a vehicle is available until it recovers or is actually destroyed.

Standing Bear was a Native American who served as a pro-Confederate militiaman during the American Civil War. After he and his comrades Jesse James and Nebediah encountered a massacre in the Ozark mountains, he was eventually killed by the assailant, a Predator, after being shot from behind by its Plasmacaster.

Skinner was a member of the species. Unlike most Yautja, Skinner had no honor and belonged to no clan, mercilessly slaughtering any creature he encountered and taking body parts as trophies. Due to his numerous violations of the Yautja Honor Code that disgraces his entire species, Yautja hunting groups were dispatched to kill him. Skinner began killing the people and creatures of New York City without restraint during a heat wave, drawing attention from both NYPD detective LaPearl, Daily Bugle Editor–in–Chief J. Jonah Jameson, and the city's resident superhero, Spider-Man. Lurking in the underground depths of the city and donning human skin as masks to fool humans (along with the Yautja's ability to mimic human voices), he came dangerously close to killing Spider-Man's girlfriend, Mary Jane Watson. Skinner was ultimately killed by Kraven the Hunter, whom the Yautja allowed to be integrated into their ranks after seeing his worth as a ruthless hunter. Kraven would then spearhead an all–out Yautja invasion of Earth alongside the Predator King's eldest son Graveyard, targeting all of Earth's heroes.

The Devil, also known as Lucifer, was a Yautja that came to Earth in the first half of the 1860's during the American Civil War. He preyed on both Confederate and Union soldiers alike during the conflict.

The Mateba Model 6 Unica is a revolver developed in Italy and sold by the Mateba company. The weapon uses the recoil from firing to rotate the cylinder and cock the hammer, unlike conventional revolvers, which depend on the user physically pulling the trigger and/or cocking the hammer to actuate the weapon's mechanism of operation. The Mateba Autorevolver's barrel alignment is different from most other revolvers. The barrel is aligned with the bottom of the cylinder instead of the top. This lowers the bore axis (line of the barrel) which directs the recoil in line with the shooter's hand thereby reducing the twisting motion or muzzle flip of normal revolvers.

An unnamed Jungle Hunter Predator was a Blooded from the Jungle Hunter Clan. The Jungle Hunter Predator was captured by the rival Super Predator Clan and forced to fight Super Predator-controlled Xenomorphs as a test of the Super Predators' control over them. After killing a few Xenomorphs, the Jungle Hunter was decapitated by a Berserker Super Predator.
Vampirella, also known as Vampi, was the titular character of her respective series and the protagonist of the 2015 crossover comic book series Aliens/Vampirella.
An unnamed Predator Warrior was a possibly Blooded that boarded in orbit of LV-426. He was killed by Private Anderson.

The Škorpion SA vz. 61 is a Czech submachine gun/machine pistol designed in 1959 for the Czechoslovak army. Intended to provide infantry units with a lightweight sidearm that would be more effective than a pistol, the Škorpion is fully-automatic with a blow-back operation, and is small enough to be fired single-handed. Officially adopted in 1961, the Škorpion saw wide use in the Czechoslovak army and was exported to several other countries. The weapon was favored for its small size and ease of use, and also quickly found its way into Criminal and Terrorist hands due to these factors.
An unnamed Predator Warrior was a possibly Blooded that boarded in orbit of LV-426. He was killed by Private Anderson.

An unnamed Warrior is the playable character in the 2001 video game Aliens versus Predator 2. It was instrumental in expanding the Xenomorph infestation on LV-1201, rescuing the Empress, capturing Dr. Eisenberg, saving the Hive from being destroyed, and killing multiple .
The Warrior Yautja, also called the Young Jungle Hunter, was tasked with a mission to stop the Super Predator Clan from destroying the Jungle Hunter Clan, by killing the Xenomorph Queen on LV-412.

A train is a form of rail transport consisting of a series of vehicles that usually runs along a rail track to transport cargo or passengers. There are various types of trains that are designed for particular purposes. A train may consist of a combination of one or more locomotives and attached railroad cars, or a self-propelled multiple unit. A freight train uses freight cars (also known as wagons or trucks) to transport goods or materials (cargo). Freight and passengers may be carried in the same train in a mixed consist. Rail cars and machinery used for maintenance and repair of tracks, etc., are termed maintenance of way equipment; these may be assembled into maintenance of way trains. Trains appear as moving vehicles in Battlefield 3, Battlefield 4 and Battlefield Hardline, as well as static objects throughout the series.

The Wraith, as it was known by the locals, was a of an unknown breed that was dwelling within a derelict Engineer ship on the planet Tirgu-Mires. The creature became the subject of legend to the locals, having claimed the lives of at least twelve youths who had entered its abode and never returned. It was eventually killed by a group of Colonial Marines sent to cover-up the creature's existence.

Yen'sha ("Edge"), was a Young Blood aboard the Kjuhte-Bhu'ja. Yen'sha was sent on a hunt with his brother Ku'dlak and clanmate R'ka to the -infested human vessel, the Theseus, to complete their Blooding Ritual. All three were successful in achieving the Blooded rank, though things were complicated when R'ka is infected by a Facehugger.
The Winterbeast was a creature native to the icy moon of Cocito. Impregnation of a Winterbeast by a facehugger led to the creation of the Winterbeast Xenomorph.

The 13.2mm Tank und Flieger (TuF) (Tank and aircraft) cartridge was created by Germany during World War I in response to armored threats such as the British Mark V tank. Originally designed to be used with the Tankgewehr M1918 rifle, it provided a means of fighting tanks that was safer to use than anti-tank mines, and less cumbersome than field guns. In response, armor on Allied vehicles was thickened, but could still be defeated by repeated hits with TuF rounds. The MG 08 machine gun was modified to fire 13.2mm ammunition, and re-dubbed the MG 18 TuF.
The Witch Predator was a female who was present in ancient Britannia. She hunted Celtic warbands and used drones.

Viktor the Chechen was the name of the cybernetic leader of the mercenary group The Machine Men. Viktor was a Russian commando who was injured and lost his arm in a failed mission. The arm was replaced with a mechanical appendage, but Viktor developed an addiction to mechanical enhancement, and became a fearsome cyborg. He gathered several like-minded individuals and formed The Machine Men. By 2030, they had garnered a reputation as fearsome mercenaries, and were under private contract to Lucretia Borgia. In 2030, the Matadores boss El Hongo was being hunted by the Scarface, and called Lucretia for help. She ordered Viktor and his crew to New Way Field, where The Machine Men waited for Scarface to arrive. The Yautja arrived, but made short work of Viktor the Chechen, taking the leader's skull as a trophy, much to Lucretia's shock.

Giacomo Costa (14 December 1919 – 22 January 2000) was an Italian Australian professional wrestler best known by his ring name, Al Costello. Costello was the first professional wrestler to be nicknamed "The Man of a Thousand Holds" because of his innovative and very technical style. Costello was the creator and original member of the tag team The Fabulous Kangaroos, whose "Ultra Australian" gimmick complete with boomerangs, bush hats and the song "Waltzing Matilda" as their entrance music, existed in various forms from 1957 until 1983. Costello was either an active wrestler, or a manager in all versions of The Fabulous Kangaroos. He and Roy Heffernan are arguably the most famous version of The Kangaroos, regarded as one of the top tag teams to ever compete in professional wrestling, and are often credited with popularizing tag team wrestling in the late 1950s and 1960s. Costello later formed other versions of The Fabulous Kangaroos with Ray St. Clair, Don Kent and Tony Charles. He also managed the team of Don Kent & Bruno Bekkar and later on "Johnny Heffernan" under The Fabulous Kangaroos name. Costello officially retired from wrestling in 1983 but still made a few brief returns to the ring after that. In 1993, he managed The New Fabulous Kangaroos (Denny Kass and Al Snow) before retiring completely from the wrestling business. Both Costello and his tag team partner Heffernan died before Kangaroos were honored as the first tag team to ever be inducted into the Professio

The Tank, Infantry, Mk III, Valentine was an infantry tank produced in the United Kingdom during the Second World War. More than 8,000 of the type were produced in eleven marks, plus various specialised variants, accounting for approximately a quarter of wartime British tank production.
Bill Kazmaier (December 30, 1983) was an American powerlifter, football player, and professional wrestler who was best known in North America for a run in World Championship Wrestling.

Miguel Wenceslao Guzmán Huerta (1916 – December 1, 1973) was a Mexican professional wrestler, or Luchador as they are known in Spanish, who worked under the ring name Miguel Guzmán and Black Guzmán, a nickname he had earned due to his dark skin.Guzmán was the brother of Rodolfo Guzmán Huerta, better known as the wrestling legend "El Santo", as well as the brother of wrestlers Pantera Negra and Jimmy Guzmán. He was the uncle of El Hijo del Santo and the great uncle of Axxel. Guzmán style was centered around the headscissors, pioneering several variations of the Headscissors takedown and one of the first Luchadors to work a fast-paced, aerial style. Guzmán was the first Mexican National Light Heavyweight Champion, winning a tournament in 1943. Guzmán also competed for Texas-based Southwest Sports, Inc. (Later World Class Championship Wrestling) for a number of years, including eight reigns as the NWA Texas Heavyweight Champion and one run with the NWA Texas Tag Team Championship alongside Rito Romero.

David Aaron Bezner (born August 15, 1969) is an American professional wrestler and motivational speaker from Syracuse, New York. He is best known for his work in World Championship Wrestling (WCW) Florida Wrestling Alliance (FWA), and Mid Florida Wrestling (MFW). Bezner currently wrestles under the ring name "The American Giant" Buck Brezner in various promotions on the independent circuit. He pioneered a new style of professional wrestling known as Powerful Strength Style.

The QJC-88 or W85 is a heavy machine gun designed in China for the People's Liberation Army. It is a further improved version of Type 54 heavy machine gun, and it was based upon the Russian DShK. The design of W85 series are heavily influenced by the Russian DShK. Despite having a similar name, it is unrelated to the Type 85 HMG.

Eric Scott Esch (August 3, 1966) commonly referred to by the ring name Butterbean, is an American boxer, kickboxer, mixed martial artist and professional wrestler who competes in the heavyweight division. Known for his rotund physique, punching power and chin, Esch transitioned to professional boxing in 1994 following a successful stint on the Toughman Contest scene and went on to capture the WAA heavyweight and IBA super heavyweight championships. Beginning in 2003, he began fighting regularly as a kickboxer and mixed martial artist, most notably in K-1 and the Pride Fighting Championships.

Joan Marie Laurer (December 27, 1970 – April 20, 2016) was an American actress and retired professional wrestler. A former bodybuilder, she was best known for her career with the World Wrestling Federation (WWF) from 1997 to 2001, where she was billed as "Chyna: "The Ninth Wonder of the World" (with the eighth wonder being André the Giant).

Celso Reyes Daza (July 28, 1961 - March 4, 2025) was a luchador, or professional wrestler, best known under his ring name Ciclón Ramírez (Spanish for "Cyclone Ramirez). Reyes worked as Pegaso I for six years before switching to the Ciclón Ramirez name in 1988. As Ramirez he originally worked as an enmascarado, or masked wrestler but was unmasked after losing a Luchas de Apuestas, or bet fight, to El Felino. The character "Ciclón Ramirez" is billed as a relative of the character Huracán Ramírez, which is a storyline invented for wrestling.

The Vickers Machine Gun was a water-cooled heavy machine gun produced by Vickers Ltd. It was primarily used by the British Army, serving as their standard heavy machine gun through both the First and Second World Wars until being retired in 1960. It was also used on many Allied aircraft during World War I, and saw service throughout the Commonwealth.

Daniel Allen "Danny" Hodge (May 13, 1932 – December 25, 2020) was a retired American wrestler and boxer. He is renowned for his wrestling career, both amateur and professional, and has also been a boxer. Hodge was born, grew up, and still lives in Perry, Oklahoma. Hodge is famous for the ability to crush apples with one hand, a feat which he demonstrated live on ESPN during the 2006 NCAA Wrestling Championships. He said his strength was due to having double tendons in his hands.
Spikers are Tier 1 Archæans that appear in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Extraction. As their name implies, they are capable of shooting projectiles from their arms.__TOC__
Blocky Morty is a Rock-type Morty in Pocket Mortys. He can't evolve.

The Universal Carrier, also known as the Bren Gun Carrier, was a family of light armored tracked vehicles that saw widespread use by British Commonwealth forces during World War II. Derived from the 1920s Carden-Loyd tankette, from its introduction in 1940 the carrier served in a variety of roles such as troop transport, logistics, support weapon platform and artillery tractor. The vehicle is one of the most manufactured armored fighting vehicles in the world, with over 113,000 units produced. In addition to the Commonwealth, the UC was delivered to other allies under the "Lend Lease" agreement, and was used by China, Soviet Union, and Free French Forces.

Concerto is a minor, one-time villain, who only appeared in the ending credits of "Pickle Rick" as well as in the theme song for Season 3. He is a music-related villain, who attempted to crush Rick and Morty with the hammers on a giant piano. He was killed by Jaguar before he could do any harm to Rick and Morty. He also killed 3 other people. He has piano teeth and piano hammer elbows.
Dragon Rider Morty is a Rock-type Morty in Pocket Mortys. He was added to the game, after the release of "Claw and Hoarder: Special Ricktim's Morty". He can't evolve.

GlorpDieBlorp is a Garblovian online game streamer. He is famous for playing jumpscare games and exploding into goo when he is really frightened, which his fans seem to expect and anticipate upon watching his stream. During his stream he receives donations from viewers, as well as blorb (some kind of food) dropping down from above him into his mouth. He was one of the earlier aliens to receive the game "Ten Tuesdays at Tinkles".

The Self Propelled 17pdr, Valentine, Mk I, Archer was a World War II British tank destroyer. Designed and manufactured by Vickers-Armstrongs, it used the Valentine Mk I tank chassis and fitted with an QF 17 pounder. 655 Archers were produced between March 1943 and May 1945. It was used in North-West Europe and Italy during the war; post-war, it served with the Egyptian Army. The vehicle was unique in that its gun faced the rear of the chassis instead of the front.

Indestructalegs Rick is a minor character in Rick and Morty Presents: The Council of Ricks. who was part of the Council of Ricks team chosen by Rick Primeminister. As the name suggests, he has Indestructible Legs.
Psychokinetic Morty appears in the game Pocket Mortys. He evolves from Telekinetic Morty and is the final evolution of Telepathic Morty.
Ronin Morty is a Paper-type Morty in Pocket Mortys. He evolves into Samurai Morty, and further evolves into Shogun Morty.
Transmission On This Truck is a Letter featured Battlefield V. It is found in the chapter Fraternite Ou La Mort of the Tirailleur War Story.
Sands of Time Morty is a Scissors-type Morty in Pocket Mortys. He evolves into Hands of Time Morty, and further evolves into Man of Time Morty.

A greatwolf, called greatwolf puppy as a baby, is an animal added by the Odyssey DLC. It is similar to the timber wolf and arctic wolf but almost twice their size. It is also wilder, faster and hungrier.
The is a returning floating demon-like monster in Risk of Rain 2, and is part of the monster family.

Vehicle Lockups are objectives featured in the Firestorm gamemode of Battlefield V. They are scattered around Halvøy and can be opened by any player. Inside each lockup is a combat vehicle as well as high tier weapons, gadgets, and ammunition.

Hob Mills was a very intelligent and powerful member of the Nuke Cult. Despite only being at the young age of 13, Hob was a ruthless and violent hoodlum, adept at both hand-to-hand fighting skills, sabotaging methods, and all firearms, from pistols to heavy weapons. As well as his formidable combat expertise, Hob was also an excellent businessman, able to manage and control a sizeable group of people many times his age, and an intelligent thinker.

Alex James Murphy (DPD ID #8788) was a dutiful, upstanding and mild-mannered Detroit Police Officer who was brutally killed in the line of duty by infamous crime boss Clarence Boddicker and his gang. Some of his organic components were later integrated into the cybernetic law enforcement entity: RoboCop - OCP Crime Prevention Unit 001, by the mega-corporation Omni Consumer Products.

Lilith (リリス, Ririsu) is a fairy, or artifact spirit (source: Wikipedia) who comes out at dusk. Though barefoot and only wearing a purple summer dress, not only is she cute, but she's a mean fairy who turns monsters in their true form. Her Japanese-language voice actress is Maria Kawamura. She is voiced by Maxey Whitehead in English. Her actual monster type is known as an artifact spirit in English, or Tsukumogami in Japanese. In Japanese, her race's or species's name comes from a term meaning "Tool kami" with "kami" meaning the literal translation in Japanese for "god" or "deity". In Japanese, this is the literal translation for "Tsukumogami".

Unrealistic Uber Rifle is a submachine gun featured in Battlefield Heroes. Available for the Soldier kit of the National Army, it was introduced in the Robots 2 bundle on January 16, 2013. Its counterpart is Surreal Super Rifle for the Royal Army and is statistically and functionally identical. Unlike other submachine guns, the weapon has the added ability to release a sphere of energy for additional damage against enemies.
Tsuchigumo also known as a Spider Monster is a species of yōkai in Rosario + Vampire. This monster is the male version of the Jorōugumo.
"Aerial Rapid Punch" is a physical attack used in the video game Pretty Soldier Sailor Moon S by Sailor Chibi Moon.
BiriBiri Dude, is a Lemures sent by JunJun to help the Amazoness Quartet extract Dream Mirrors. He was an electric catfish with a microphone and appeared in Episode 33 of the fourth season.

The Tirpitz was the second of two built for Nazi Germany's during World War II. Named after the architect of the German Imperial Navy , the ship was laid down in 1936 with work being completed in February 1941. At 42,900 tonnes, the Tirpitz was the largest battleship ever constructed by a European power. For the majority of its time in service, the Tirpitz was stationed in Norway and tasked with intercepting Allied supply convoys to the Soviet Union. The threat of the battleship as a forced the to retain powerful naval forces in the as a means of containing it. The battleship was sunk on November 12th 1944 by RAF .

Balm (バーム, Baamu) is a Monster of Jadeite who enlists her help upon noticing the energy humans invest in seeking to know their future through clairvoyance. Balm manipulates her victims by planting a devil tarot card into her victims, which causes them to behave mischievously around people.
Grape (グレープ, Gureepu) is a Monster from the Dark Kingdom and one of the Plant Sisters who works for Zoisite. She can extend her arms and shoot thorns, and detach them if they stab a target.

Hellant is the 4th Cardian that Ail and An sent to drain energy for the Makai Tree. She possessed tentacles that extend from her hair and her back to drain energy from people. She appeared in episode 4 of Sailor Moon R.

The Nambu Submachine Gun (南部短機関銃) were two prototype Japanese submachine guns developed in 1934—1935 and produced by the Nambu Arms Manufacturing Company. The two prototypes were respectively named Prototype 1 (一号案) and Prototype 2 (二号案). It had two experimental models, differentiated by kanji numerals and respectively named Experimental Model 1 (試製一型) and Experimental Model 2 (試製二型), usually anglicized as Type 2A and Type 2B. The Type 2 was one of the first submachine guns to feed magazines through the pistol grip. It was trialed by the Imperial Japanese Army in the mid-1930s and offered for commercial export, but saw no sales. Very few examples were made. While there have been no combat records of the Type 2A, it has been reported that the Type 2B was received by US forces in Okinawa, so there is a possibility that a number of Type 2A made their way inside among the chaos of the war.

Ghost Cistern (ゴースト シスターン, Goosuto Shisutaan) is a genius loci who appears in the manga's third Exam Battle side story: Rei and Minako's Girls School Battle?. She is a ghost from the Edo era who resides in a well outside T.A. Girls' Academy.
Iguara (イグアーラ, Iguaara) is a lizard Monster from the Dark Kingdom ordered by Jadeite to steal human energy by exploiting the human feeling of desire.
Kyokubadanko is the second Lemure that was sent by Tiger's Eye to fight the Sailor Guardians during his attack on Reika Nishimura.

The was a bolt-action rifle design and used by the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. First introduced in 1939, the weapon intended to replace the 6.5x50mm Type 38 Arisaka then in service, with the Type 99 firing the new 7.7x58mm cartridge which proved superior at range.

Morga (モルガ, Moruga) is the first Monster to appear in the first season of Sailor Moon in the first episode, as well as the first Monster to gather human energy for the Dark Kingdom to revive Queen Metalia. Morga heavily discounts jewelry charged with dark energy under the disguise of Naru's mother, whom she attacks and locks in the basement of her own store. While disguised as her mother, Morga attempts to strangle Naru for questioning her over the loss of consciousness customers are experiencing from having their energy drained from the jewelry they purchased.
Ms. TogeToge is a Lemures sent by CereCere to fight Sailor Moon in Sailor Moon SuperS.

:Not to be confused with the Sailor Animamate, Sailor Heavy Metal Papillon. Papillon (パピヨン, Papiyon) is the 6th Monster created by Kunzite. She is created when Kunzite turns Katarina into a monster in order to get close to Sailor V.

The 200mm Gun is the primary [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coastal_artillery coastal artillery] used by the Imperial Japanese Army during its defense of Peleliu Island during the Pacific campaign of World War II. It was used as an anti-ship weapon.
PallaPalla (パラパラ, ParaPara) is one of the members of the Amazoness Quartet who serves Zirconia and Queen Nehelenia.
Minotauron is the 2nd Cardian that Ail and A send to drain energy. She is a savage beast that attacks by using her horns, which can extend to great lengths and drain energy from people.

is a hot-headed and impulsive soldier of the Klessirpemdo that uses the Lance, Blazecleaver, and made her only appearance in Soulcalibur III's Chronicles of the Sword. Her nickname was the "Fires of Hell".

The 2K12 Kub is a large Russian tracked medium range surface-to-air missile. It is designed to destroy hostile cruise missiles, aircraft, helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicles. The 2K12 Kub can be seen as a static vehicle in multiple levels in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, and appears as scenery in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.

Watchers are beings similar to [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Familiar familiar spirits], animals malfested for the sake of collecting shards and gathering information for Soul Edge. Cervantes employed a small shark and Nightmare possessed a black hawk. Using a fragment of the evil sword, Tira is accompanied by a large number of crow watchers, gathering shards for Nightmare and examining information from several locations while she awaits for a chance to restore her master's power.

Darakian is a rogue protoss Dark Templar. A solitary, silent individual, Darakian is like many Dark Templar in that he has never abandoned his love for Aiur. He considers the Khala a genuine threat to the protoss. At some point, likely during the zerg invasion of the Koprulu Sector, Darakian abandoned the Dark Templar space vessel on which he lived and offered his services to the , seeking a way to eradicate the zerg before they destroy protoss civilization. While he has no great love for terrans, he's willing to work with them to eradicate the zerg. In turn, the Alliance only tolerates him for his skills and knowledge of the zerg. A few years after the , Darakian and an elite Alliance squad took part in a mission to Dylar Station and Dylar IV itself, Darakian earning a medal for his trouble.

Derek was a terran who lived on Tarsonis, employed as a servant by the Terra Family. It was a position that got him killed, for during the Great War, a group of rebels infiltrated the Terra Skyscraper, intent on murdering the family. Derek was not killed by the rebels however, but rather as a result of November Terra unleashing her telekinesis in a massive psychic attack.
The was an allied military unit during World War II. They appear in Call of Duty 3 as one of the playable factions, focusing on Bohater and his tank crew.

Dori Koogler is a ghost trainee assigned to Team Red. She attempted to participate in the Ghost Academy's hydralisk combat simulation, but was unable to when Team Blue destroyed the robotic hydralisks. Koogler was removed from Team Red when political pressure forced the to let Aal Cistler return. Cistler demanded to be on Team Red, and he took her place.

Dehaka is a primal zerg pack leader from Zerus. He was among the last of the primal zerg pack leaders prior to Kerrigan's arrival. Dehaka is bipedal with two pairs of arms, one large and one small, though he is missing his right large arm and left small one.

Ewan Welke is regarded as the greatest living bard of modern (future) times. He spent many years at Zephyr Cove, composing a haiku piece that gave the cove its name; peaceful island cove blessed by the ocean's cool breath the zephyr moves me

1987 Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch. The playercard for the pack has the camouflage in the background with phrase "Can't Touch This" on it, referencing to MC Hammer. The patch is a pair of shorts covered in the camouflage.

Elois Magwitch, nicknamed "Mags," was an enforcer in service to the crime lord Fagin. The crime lord considered Mags to be of little value. He had a sister. Mags was called to defend Fagin's HQ from a rogue telepath, mainly as a distraction, as Fagin didn't expect him to even survive. Due to the target's psionic powers, he failed miserably when she jammed their guns. After the conflict ended with Poppo and Two-Bit dead, Mags decided that Nova wasn't worth losing his life, and stopped the attack.

Dylanna Okyl was a terran ghost and spectre. During her time in the Ghost Academy, she didn't get along with Nova Terra, since the latter is not a team player. She refers to Terra as "the Blonde" and "Blondie" in order to irritate her.

Farley was a Confederate marine and goliath pilot during the Guild Wars. He had a "high wattage" personality, a strong grip, eyes that looked like "gun barrels" and a face that looked too young for his age, along with strange jaw movement. Jim Raynor speculated from this that he might have undergone facial reconstruction for wounds suffered in combat.
The 48 Dredge (known as Ares in the beta files) is a 6 round auto burst fire Light Machine Gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

Ghost No. 24506 was the designation for a male terran conscripted into the Ghost Program. He was skilled in [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Close_quarters_combat CQC] and possessed a significant level of psionic power.
Dr. Gauthier is a scientist who does psionic experimentation at the . One of his test subjects was Colin Phash, who had unusual psychic abilities.
Franko Tildon was a terran. He was a mass murderer before being reformed. As a marine, he was credited as the first "fighting firebat".

The 50mm Pathfinder is a Jackal-mounted weapon featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. In multiplayer, the Mauler - Mammoth variant has the gun perk Heavy Hitter, which converts the weapon's barrel to fire rounds from the 50mm Pathfinder.

Fiorello was an investigator who worked for the Ghost Program of the Terran Confederacy. After a young Nova Terra used a mind blast that killed 300 people around the Terra Skyscraper, Fiorello was assigned by Director Ilsa Killiany to replace Malcolm Kelerchian in handling the murder scene, with Kelerchian being assigned to track down Nova.

Five is a spectre, and was a part of Emperor Arcturus Mengsk's attempts to revive Project Shadowblade. Though given no real name, her designation was one given by terran reporter Donny Vermillion in order to tell the spectres apart.

Great apes are creatures believed to have resided on Earth by the inhabitants of the Koprulu sector. Known for climbing buildings and swatting down primitive aircraft, they are believed to be one and the same species as gorillas.
The 20mm Dragonfly is a Jackal-mounted weapon featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

The High Templar Hero was a powerful high templar who assisted in the war between the settlers of Shakuras and Ulrezaj. Ulrezaj had stolen a sacred khaydarin crystal from Shakuras, and while tracking it, the protoss discovered that Ulrezaj had created five twisted khaydarin crystals on Char. He was using them to control zerg minions. Zeratul needed a dark archon to destroy the warped crystals, as only its psychic fury was capable of it. This Dark Archon Hero was accompanied by the High Templar Hero as well as several other heroes.

Hieronymous Jones, nicknamed "Jonesy" due to the trouble people had pronouncing his first name, was a follower of the crime lord Fagin. He possessed a Z50 pistol named 'Karla', named after the first girl he ever dated. His pretense to name his weapons earned him the ire of Fagin. Jones was called to defend Fagin from a rogue telepath. In this he failed miserably, getting his pistol destroyed by the girl's psionic powers.

Gregg Moonstone, a very large man, was a member of a secretive Terran Confederacy military unit, alongside Gustav Lorca, Kon Rennie, Romy Pyrius, Jupiter Ross and Banta West. Pyrius was unsure if this was his real name. In 2483 he and the rest of the team raided a meeting to kill the targets. However, Pyrius, a drug dealer, had hatched a side deal which compromised the mission. The other organization captured Pyrius and Moonstone. They intended to tamper with Pyrius drugs and have him assassinate their own targets that way. They tested their product on Moonstone, killing him. Pyrius was the only survivor of the original mission.
The 4x Optic is a weapon attachment featured in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Hiram Feek was a civilian terran technician and designer of the CMC-230 XE/XF Thunderstrike combat suit series, which were capable of great leaps, as well as limited flight (when dropped from dropships). Feek was only four feet tall. He shaved his head and wore a luxurious mustache.

Ilsa Killiany was the Director of the Terran Confederacy Ghost Program, a position she felt that she was born to. Killiany could "bend the universe to her will" in order to acquire powerful telepaths for the Confederacy. She had the rank to order generals around and could give "advice" to the Confederacy Council. As far as she was concerned, ghosts were the last line of defense for the Confederacy against aliens and rebels.
Infested medics are terran medics who have undergone zerg infestation. They retain their ability to heal allied biological units.
The 6x Optic is a weapon attachment featured Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Kal-taar are small, extremely swift creatures indigenous to Aiur. They are not predators, relying on their speed to escape creatures that hunt them. During the Aeon of Strife, the Shelak Tribe bestowed spiritual importance on the kal-taar, calling upon the "spirit of kal-taar" when hunting.

Kare Vaessen is a terran ghost of college age. She possesses exceptional intelligence and psionic potential and, somewhat uniquely for a ghost, a moral character. Considered cold and unfriendly by those who don't know her, Vaessen takes no pleasure in her mission profiles and longs to leave her business as an assassin behind her. Still, she's willing to blow every alien enemy to hell to do it.

Joel was a member of Cliff Nadaner's anti-Dominion terrorist group. He had recently gotten divorced before hiding in a dead zone with the other terrorists on Tyrador VIII. The group was met by Dominion agent Nova, who quickly slew them with her mental powers.

The (later renamed as 509th Tactical Fighter Squadron) was established as a dive-bomber squadron in early 1943, trained under Third Air Force with A-24 Banshees. They converted to a P-39 Airacobra squadron in August and finally into a P-47 Thunderbolt fighter squadron in late 1943. The squadron was inactivated in 1992 as a result of the end of the Cold War and general reduction of USAFE forces afterward. In Call of Duty: WWII, the player take control of 2nd Lt. Matthew Weber. Under Rover Joe's command, the squadron's orders are to protect a bomber squadron to assist the 1st Infantry Division in the level Battle of the Bulge.
Jimmy is a terran firebat. At some point, Jimmy engaged in a game of rounding up zerglings with Billy Bob, a fellow firebat, the loser having to buy the keg of beer.

Jara was a ghost of the Terran Dominion before being recruited by Project Shadowblade. Her identity was restored and thanks to terrazine exposure, her psionic powers intensified. During the Spectre Rebellion, she took part in a mission to Korhal Palace under the command of fellow spectre Gabriel Tosh. The mission was to assassinate Arcturus Mengsk. However, it failed due to the intervention of Agent Nova Terra. Jara was killed during the conflict, and her death weighed heavily on Tosh.

L. Z. Breanne was a highly authoritarian terran marine lieutenant of the Confederate Marine Corps. Breanne possessed close-cropped blond hair that stood in neat bristles from a well-shaved scalp, a tight face with angular cheek bones and shining, steel-tinged eyes which "could freeze a river solid in midsummer."

.458 SOCOM 10-Round Mags is an attachment for the M4A1 in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone. It is a conversion kit which chambers the gun in .458 SOCOM rounds which have increased damage and range. However, the fire rate of the gun is reduced alongside the ammo capacity and a reduction in recoil control.

MacGregor Golding is a male terran ghost, serving in Alpha Squadron. He has a small, "streetwise" face, overlarge eyes and high cheekbones that look incredibly old. Due to years of physical training in isolation, he possesses exceptional stamina and resistance to the negative effects of stimulants.

The manipulator is a cut protoss unit from StarCraft II: Legacy of the Void. Little data for the unit exists in the , only few text info in localization files. The description indicates the manipulator was either the Nerazim or Purifier variant of the sentry, and could use Combat Chrono Aura and Force Push.

Miratix is a rogue Dark Templar. He often claims that his actions are for the greater good of the protoss race, but in reality, he is simply an individual who looks out for himself. In addition to the standard abilities of a Dark Templar, Miratix can cast psionic bolts.

5.56 NATO Mags are attachments for the AUG submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile. They appear as the 5.56 NATO 30-Round Mags and 5.56 NATO 60-Round Drums, each supporting their own set of stats.

A monstrosity is a zerg creature spawned by Abathur from the bodies of other organisms. It attacks through four massive tendrils, and can be controlled directly by a symbiote. Its appearance resembles that of Abathur.
Nerath is a Nerazim phase-smith (or phase-smith equivalent), with a dry and witty sense of humor. She is unusually short for a protoss, and has dusty dark skin.
November Annabella "Nova" Terra (designation: Agent X41822N) is a ghost who served the Terran Dominion.
The 25×59mm Explosive Mag is an attachment for the Rytec AMR sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.
The observer is a small, stealthy robotic protoss reconnaissance unit.

Paul was a terran who served the anti-Confederate rebel/terrorist Cliff Nadaner. He took part in a successful raid against the Terra Family, though he believed that the Confederate Council was a more worthwhile target than the Old Families. He never got a chance to attack his preferred target however, as he was killed by one of the family member's psionic powers.

Nuura Joss is a terran outlaw and member of the War Pigs. Joss sometimes wears a green CMC-300 Powered Combat Suit. Joss is trained in hand-to-hand, knife and firearm combat. Unlike the other War Pigs, she has been trained to follow orders. She was considered a valuable team member due to her ability to pilot warp travel-capable vessels.
The 25×59mm Thermite Mag is an attachment for the Rytec AMR sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.

One is a spectre, and was a part of Emperor Arcturus Mengsk's attempts to revive Project Shadowblade. Fiercely loyal to the Dominion, One was seen as the leader of the batch of six spectres. He was bald, had medium brown skin, and a stocky build. As he lacked a proper name, it was one given by terran reporter Donny Vermillion in order to tell the spectres apart.

Ray was a terran who followed anti-Dominion rebel/terrorist Cliff Nadaner. A few years after the , he found himself on Tyrador VIII, although he had a girlfriend on Halcyon whom he wanted to get back to. He never reunited with her however, as a Dominion ghost killed him and the rest of Nadaner's team via psionic powers.
